rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Los removeedores de maquillaje con agua micelar son suaves para la piel sensible, pero efectivos en romper fácilmente fórmulas waterproof.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Gentle water-based makeup removers are effective in easily removing waterproof makeup.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Contouring with cream products offers a more dewy, natural finish than using matte powder formulas, particularly for dry skin.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Usar produtos cremosos para contornear oferece um acabamento mais suave e natural do que usar fórmulas de pó matte, especialmente para pele seca.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Using cream products can provide a smoother and more natural finish compared to powder-based matte formulas, especially for dry skin.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: While group fitness classes are fun, some clients request private personal training to target unique mobility challenges or specialized goals.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Enquanto as aulas de fitness em grupo são divertidas, alguns clientes pedem treinamento pessoal privado para abordar desafios de mobilidade únicos ou metas especializadas.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: While group fitness classes are enjoyable, some clients prefer private training to address unique mobility challenges or specialized goals.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Shimmery highlighters capture light and create the illusion of lifted cheekbones, a favorite technique among professional makeup artists.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Los iluminadores con reflejos capturan la luz y crean la ilusión de pómulos levantados, una técnica favorita entre los profesionales de maquillaje.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The illuminators with reflections capture light and create the illusion of raised cheeks, a technique often used by makeup professionals.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Fitness trackers can monitor heart rate variability, sleep quality, calorie expenditure, and even hydration throughout vigorous training cycles.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Los rastreadores de fitness pueden monitorear la variabilidad de la frecuencia cardíaca, la calidad del sueño, el gasto calórico, y hasta la hidratación a lo largo de ciclos de entrenamiento vigorosos.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Fitness trackers can monitor heart rate variability, sleep quality, caloric expenditure, and hydration levels during intense workout cycles.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Applying a clarifying scalp mask once a month can help remove product buildup and promote healthy hair growth.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Aclarando el cuero cabelludo con un tratamiento de máscara una vez al mes puede ayudar a eliminar el exceso de producto y promover el crecimiento saludable del cabello.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Regularly clarifying the scalp with a mask treatment once a month can help remove excess product and promote healthy hair growth.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Do lifting belts really support the lower back during deadlifts and squats, or is their benefit overstated?
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Assegurar que los cinturones de levantamiento realmente apoyan la espalda baja durante sentadillas y sentadillas, o si su beneficio es sobreestimado.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: To ensure that suspension straps genuinely support the lower back during squats and lunges, or if their benefits are overstated.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Vegan collagen boosters claim to improve skin elasticity, but clinical studies on their efficacy remain limited compared to animal-derived sources.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Los potenciadores de colágeno veganos afirman mejorar la elasticidad de la piel, pero los estudios clínicos sobre su eficacia siguen siendo limitados en comparación con los fuentes de origen animal.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Vegan collagen boosters claim to improve skin elasticity, but clinical studies on their effectiveness are still limited compared to animal-derived sources.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: You may notice improved skin texture after switching from abrasive scrubs to chemical exfoliants like glycolic or lactic acid.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Se puede observar una mejor textura de la piel después de cambiar de los esbajos abrasivos a los exfoliantes químicos como ácido glicólico o ácido láctico.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: After switching from abrasive scrubs to chemical exfoliants like glycolic or lactic acid, one can observe a better texture of the skin.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Using a jade roller can temporarily reduce facial puffiness, especially when kept chilled overnight before morning use.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Usando un rolo de jade puede reducir temporalmente la hinchazón facial, especialmente cuando se mantiene frío durante la noche antes del uso matutino.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Using a jade roller can temporarily reduce facial swelling, especially when kept cold at night before morning use.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: She adapted her workout split to include upper-lower body supersets for improved efficiency during busy weeks.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Ella adaptou o seu plano de exercícios para incluir supersets de corpo superior-inferior para maior eficiência durante semanas ocupadas.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: She adapted her exercise plan to include supersets of upper-lower body exercises for increased efficiency during busy weeks.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: She prefers a lightweight BB cream on gym days since it provides coverage without suffocating her skin during exercise.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Ella prefiere un BB light durante los días de gimnasio, ya que proporciona cobertura sin opacar su piel durante el ejercicio.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: She prefers a BB light during gym days as it provides coverage without making her skin look washed out while exercising.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Fitness boot camps offer structured group challenges, HIIT elements, and team-building exercises over four-to-six-week programs for all levels.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Campos de entrenamiento de alto rendimiento ofrecen desafíos en grupo estructurados, elementos HIIT y ejercicios de equipo-construcción durante programas de cuatro a seis semanas para todos los niveles.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: High-performance training fields offer structured group challenges, HIIT elements, and team-building exercises in 4-6 week programs for all levels.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Regular use of chemical peels can diminish the appearance of acne scars, even out pigmentation, and revitalize dull skin if professionally administered.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Uso regular de peel químico puede disminuir la apariencia de cicatrices de acné, igualar la pigmentación y revitalizar la piel apagada si se aplica profesionalmente.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Regular use of chemical peel can diminish the appearance of acne scars, even out skin tone, and revitalize dull skin when applied professionally.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: By applying a primer formulated for oily skin, she ensures foundation stays matte and resists shine under stage lights at fitness competitions.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Ao aplicar um primer formulado para a pele oleosa, ela garante que o corretivo permaneça matizado e resiste ao brilho sob as luzes de palco em competições de fitness.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: After applying a primer formulated for oily skin, it ensures that the concealer stays matte and resists shine under stage lights in fitness competitions.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Fitness influencers frequently share progress photos, training tips, and product endorsements to inspire followers and build their personal brands online.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Los influenciadores en fitness comparten frecuentemente fotos de progreso, consejos de entrenamiento y endoresimientos de productos para inspirar a sus seguidores y construir su marca personal en línea.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Fitness influencers frequently share photos of progress, training advice, and product endorsements to inspire their followers and build their online personal brand.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Using purple shampoo once a week can counteract brassiness in bleached blonde hair without the need for salon toners.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Usando champú roxo uma vez por semana pode neutralizar a cor amarelada em cabelos loiros escovados sem a necessidade de toners no salão.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Using red shampoo once a week can neutralize yellowed hair color in light hair, without the need for salon toners.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Her trainer uses periodization, altering her rep schemes and rest intervals monthly to prevent plateaus and optimize muscle growth.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: O'se entrenador usa la periodización, alterando sus esquemas de repeticiones y los intervalos de descanso mensualmente para prevenir los picos y optimizar el crecimiento muscular.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The coach uses periodization, altering his repetition schemes and rest intervals monthly to prevent plateaus and optimize muscle growth.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: It is advisable to invest in a professional makeup brush cleaner to maintain tool hygiene and ensure optimal application of cream and powder products.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Recomendable invertir en un limpiador de brochas profesionales para mantener la higiene de las herramientas y garantizar el uso óptimo de productos de crema y polvos.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Recommended to invest in a professional brush cleaner to maintain hygiene of tools and ensure optimal use of cream and powder products.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Agatha Christie's mysteries remain among the best-selling books of all time.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Así son los libros de Agatha Christie, siguen siendo los más vendidos de todos los tiempos.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Agatha Christie's books are still the best-sellers of all time.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: You should check the bibliography for more scholarly sources on postcolonial literature.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Mora cheche la bibliografia para fontes scholarly sobre literatura postcolonial.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: I'm looking for scholarly sources on postcolonial literature.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Her memoir is praised for its candid narrative and poetic language.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Asu memoire praised por sua narrativa candida e linguagem poética.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Asu memoire praised for its candid and poetic narrative.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: These essays critique the evolution of feminist themes in twentieth-century fiction.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Estos ensaios critican el desarrollo de temas feministas en la ficción del siglo XX.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: These studies criticize the development of feminist themes in fiction from the 20th century.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Do you prefer reading epistolary novels or omniscient narration?
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: ¿Prefieres leer novelas epistolaras o una narración omnisciente?
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Do you prefer reading epistolary novels or a narrative with an all-knowing narrator?

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The quarterly literary journal features emerging poets from diverse backgrounds.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: O jornal literário trimestral apresenta poetas emergentes de diversos contextos culturais.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The literary quarterly journal features emerging poets from various cultural backgrounds.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Each chapter begins with a relevant excerpt from classic literature.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Cada capítulo começa com um trecho relevante de literatura clássica.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Each chapter begins with a relevant excerpt from classical literature.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The protagonist's Bildungsroman arc resonates with many adolescent readers.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: A arc do Bildungsroman do protagonista resonará com muitos leitores adolescentes.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The protagonist's arc in a Bildungsroman will resonate with many adolescent readers.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: She uses a pen name to separate her romance novels from her noir thrillers.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Ella usa un seudónimo para separar sus novelas románticas de sus thrillers de noir.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: She uses a pseudonym to separate her romantic novels from her noir thrillers.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The collected letters between the author and her editor shed light on the creative process behind the manuscript.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Así se reflejan las cartas reunidas entre la autora y su editor, iluminando el proceso creativo detrás del manuscrito.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The collected letters between the author and their editor shed light on the creative process behind the manuscript.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The preface outlines the historical context that influenced the poet's major works during the early Romantic period.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Anexo introduz a contexto histórico que influenciou os principais trabalhos do poeta durante o início do período romântico.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The appendix introduces the historical context that influenced the poet's major works during the early romantic period.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: With its clever wordplay and satirical tone, the book appeals to both young readers and adults alike.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Conjuntamente com sua jogada de palavras e tom satírico, o livro atrai tanto leitores jovens quanto adultos.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The book's combination of wordplay and satirical tone appeals to both young readers and adults.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The Oxford English Dictionary traces the etymology of countless words used throughout Shakespeare's plays and sonnets.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: A dictionary da Oxford traces a historia de miles de palabras usadas em todas as peças e sonetos de Shakespeare.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: A dictionary by Oxford traces the history of thousands of words used in all of Shakespeare's plays and sonnets.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Which of the three major literary movements most influenced the structure and diction of this piece of fiction?
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Que uma das três principais correntes literárias mais influenciou a estrutura e a dicção deste trabalho de ficção?
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Which of the three main literary currents most influenced the structure and diction of this fictional work?

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The poet's use of enjambment in these stanzas creates a sense of urgency and fluid movement across the lines.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Apo o poeta usa o enjambamento nestas estrofes cria um sentido de urgência e movimento fluído das linhas.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The poet uses enjambment in these verses to create a sense of urgency and fluid movement of lines.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: What distinguishes magical realism from traditional fantasy genres in Latin American literature?
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: En qué se diferencia la realismo mágico de los géneros tradicionales de fantasía en la literatura latinoamericana?
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: What distinguishes magical realism from traditional fantasy genres in Latin American literature?

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Revision notes indicate the author made significant changes to the plot structure after feedback from beta readers.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Aspectos de revisión indican que el autor realizó cambios significativos en la estructura de la trama tras la retroalimentación de lectores beta.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Review aspects indicate that the author made significant changes to the plot structure after beta reader feedback.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Literary critics have debated the authenticity of the lost manuscript allegedly discovered in a Parisian attic.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Literary kritiks habebate la autentiko de la manuscrita perdida alegada descubrida en un atrio de Paris.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Literary critics have debated the authenticity of the lost manuscript allegedly discovered in a Paris attic.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Which translation of 'The Odyssey' do you recommend for readers new to ancient Greek epics?
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: ¿Cuál es la traducción de 'La Odisea' que recomiendas para lectores nuevos a las épicas griegas antiguas?
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: What is your recommendation for the translation of 'The Odyssey' for new readers of ancient Greek epics?

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The local library hosts weekly readings from banned books to promote intellectual freedom and literary diversity.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: A biblioteca local promove a liberdade intelectual e a diversidade literária ao oferecer leituras semanais de livros banidos.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The local library promotes intellectual freedom and literary diversity by offering weekly readings of banned books.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Her poetry collections have won numerous awards, including the Pulitzer Prize for Poetry in 2012.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Sus poesías ganaron varios premios, incluyendo el Premio Pulizer de Poesía en 2012.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Her poems won several awards, including the 2012 Pulitzer Prize for Poetry.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: This biography chronicles the tumultuous life and enduring literary legacy of Virginia Woolf.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Esta biografia retrata a vida tumultuosa e a heráldica literaria duradoura de Virginia Woolf.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: This biography depicts the tumultuous and enduring literary heraldry of Virginia Woolf.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The futuristic society depicted in this dystopian novel reflects the author's anxiety about surveillance and loss of individual autonomy.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: A novela distópica futurista, retratada nessa sociedade, reflete o medo do autor da vigilância e da perda da autonomia individual.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: A dystopian futuristic novel, depicted in this society, reflects the author's fear of surveillance and loss of individual autonomy.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The author's stream-of-consciousness narrative style demands careful attention and often requires multiple readings to fully appreciate.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: A autora's estilo narrativo em fluxo de consciência exige atenção cuidadosa e muitas vezes requer leituras múltiplas para apreciar completamente.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The author's narrative style in stream-of-consciousness requires careful attention and often multiple readings to fully appreciate.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Early editions of 'Pride and Prejudice' are highly sought-after among rare book collectors worldwide.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Asraras da edicións iniciais de 'Pride and Prejudice' son altamente buscadas por los coleccionistas de libros raros en todo el mundo.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Initial editions of 'Pride and Prejudice' are highly sought after by rare book collectors worldwide.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The editorial board selected this author because her writing challenges conventional genres and blurs boundaries between memoir and fiction.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Araza la mesa editorial, seleccionaron a esta autora porque su escritura desafía géneros convencionales y confunde fronteras entre memorias y ficción.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The editorial board selected this author because their writing defies conventional genres and blurs the lines between memoir and fiction.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Does the protagonist's ambiguous moral choices reflect the broader uncertainties of postmodern literature?
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Aguá a moralidades ambíguas do protagonista refletem as incertezas mais amplas da literatura pós-moderna?
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The ambivalent moralities of the protagonist reflect the broader uncertainties of postmodern literature?

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The publishing house acquired North American rights to the debut novel for a record sum in 2021.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: La casa de publicaciones adquirió los derechos de Norteamérica para el debut novel en un monto récord en 2021.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The publishing house acquired North American rights to the author's debut novel in a record-breaking amount in 2021.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Literary awards often influence which books gain mainstream attention and receive coverage in prominent newspapers and magazines.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Literary premios frecuentemente afectan en qué libros ganan la atención general y reciben cobertura en periódicos y revistas prominentes.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Literary awards frequently influence which books gain general attention and receive coverage in prominent newspapers and magazines.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The motif of lost innocence recurs throughout the coming-of-age novels shortlisted for this year's National Book Award.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Amotif de inocencia perdida se repite a lo largo de los novelas de crecimiento en esta selección para el Premio Nacional de Literatura este año.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: A motif of innocence lost is repeated throughout the novels of this selection for the National Literature Prize this year.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Some printing errors in the first edition are prized by collectors for their rarity and the insight they provide into historical publishing practices.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: En la primera edición hay errores de impresión preciosos para los coleccionistas por su rara y la luz que proporcionan en las prácticas de publicación históricas.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: In the first edition, there are precious printing errors for collectors due to their rarity and the light they provide in historical publication practices.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The decision to serialize the novel in a literary magazine helped build anticipation and broaden its readership before official publication.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: A decisão de serializar o romance em uma revista literária ajudou a construir a expectativa e ampliar a audiência antes da publicação oficial.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The decision to serialize the novel in a literary magazine helped build anticipation and expand the audience before the official publication.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: If you analyze the symbolic significance of color imagery in this short story, you may uncover new layers of meaning beyond the surface narrative.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Analizar la significación simbólica de la imagen de color en esta historia corta puede revelar nuevas capas de significado más allá de la narrativa superficial.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Analyzing the symbolic meaning of the color image in this short story can reveal new layers of meaning beyond the superficial narrative.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The author's personal experiences of exile deeply inform the themes and emotional resonance present in her body of work.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: As autor, suas experiências pessoais de exílio influenciam profundamente os temas e a ressonância emocional presente em sua obra.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: As personal experiences of the author as an exile significantly influence the themes and emotional resonance of their work.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Scholars have debated whether the fragmentary structure of this poem is intentional or the result of lost original verses over time.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Los estudiosos han discutido sobre si la estructura fragmentaria de este poema es intencional o el resultado de versos originales perdidos con el tiempo.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Scholars have debated whether the fragmented structure of this poem is intentional or the result of lost original verses over time.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The protagonist's unreliable narration forces readers to question the veracity of every event, complicating traditional interpretations of good and evil within the novel.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: A unreliable narrador del protagonista hace que los lectores cuestionen la verdad de cada evento, complicando las interpretaciones tradicionales del bien y del mal en la novela.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: A unreliable narrator of the protagonist makes readers question the truth of each event, complicating traditional interpretations of good and evil in the novel.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The widespread impact of this trilogy on modern science fiction literature cannot be overstated, inspiring adaptations, critical studies, and a devoted international fan base.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Este trilogía ha tenido un impacto generalizado en la literatura de ciencia ficción moderna, lo que ha inspirado adaptaciones, estudios críticos y una base de seguidores internacionales devotas.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: This trilogy has had a widespread impact on modern science fiction literature, inspiring adaptations, critical studies, and a devoted international following.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: When compiling a literary anthology, editors must carefully select representative works that highlight thematic diversity while maintaining a cohesive overarching narrative.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Quando se compila una antología literaria, los editores deben seleccionar cuidadosamente obras representativas que destaquen la diversidad temática mientras mantienen una narrativa general coherente.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: When compiling a literary anthology, editors must carefully select representative works that highlight thematic diversity while maintaining a coherent narrative structure.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Historical fiction frequently employs real-world settings and events as a backdrop for imaginative reinterpretation and character-driven narratives.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: La ficción histórica frecuentemente utiliza escenarios y eventos reales del mundo para reinterpretar imaginativamente y contar historias basadas en personajes.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Historical fiction often uses real-world scenarios and events as a basis for imaginative reinterpretation and storytelling.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Her deft use of metaphor throughout the poetry collection transforms everyday experiences into profound meditations on mortality, love, and self-discovery.
World-building in epic fantasy series often necessitates the creation of detailed maps, invented languages, and elaborate genealogies for multiple noble families.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: En la creación de mundo en las series de fantasía épica, frecuentemente se requiere la creación de mapas detallados, idiomas inventados y genealogías elaboradas para múltiples familias nobles.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: In the creation of epic fantasy series, detailed maps, invented languages, and elaborate genealogies for multiple noble families are often required.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Allegorical storytelling in Renaissance literature frequently disguised political critique beneath layers of symbolism and religious allegory.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: En literatura renacentista, a alegoria narrativa frequentemente esconde críticas políticas por baixo de camadas de simbolismo e alegoria religiosa.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: In Renaissance literature, allegorical narrative often conceals political criticism beneath layers of symbolic and religious allegory.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Metafictional narrative techniques blur the boundaries between author, text, and reader by actively acknowledging the artifice of the storytelling process.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Aspectos narrativos metafísicos envueltos en la narrativa, aluzan los límites entre el autor, el texto y el lector, al reconocer y acotar la artificiosidad del proceso de narración.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Metaphysical narrative aspects intertwined in the narrative, highlighting the boundaries between the author, the text, and the reader, by acknowledging and delimiting the artificiality of the narration process.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The resurgence of interest in memoirs reflects a broader cultural fascination with personal storytelling and the blurred line between fact and fiction.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Aumento do interesse em memórias reflete uma maior fascinção cultural com a narrativa pessoal e a linha escura entre fato e ficção.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Increased interest in memories reflects a growing cultural fascination with personal narratives and the blurred line between fact and fiction.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The ongoing debate surrounding literary canons challenges traditional assumptions about whose voices and stories deserve preservation and scholarly attention.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Aguante el debate sobre los canones literarios cuestiona las suposiciones tradicionales sobre las voces y las historias que merecen preservación y atención académica.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The debate on literary canons challenges traditional assumptions about the voices and stories deserving preservation and academic attention.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Multi-layered symbolism in this experimental novel demands a sophisticated reader willing to engage with abstract themes and unconventional structure.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Este novela experimental apresenta múltiplos níveis de simbolismo, exigindo um leitor sofisticado disposto a se envolver com temas abstratos e estrutura não convencional.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: This experimental novel features multiple layers of symbolism, requiring a sophisticated reader willing to engage with abstract themes and unconventional structure.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The adaptation of classic literature into graphic novels makes these stories accessible to new generations while preserving their essential themes and motifs.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Adiangana de literatura clásica a historietas hace accesible estas historias a nuevas generaciones, preservando sus temas y motivos esenciales.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Adiangana translates to'simplifies' or'makes accessible.' The text means 'Classical literature is being adapted into comics to make these stories accessible to new generations, preserving their essential themes and motifs.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Recognizing genre conventions can help readers better appreciate satirical works that subvert familiar literary tropes.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Recognizing genre conventions can help readers better understand and appreciate satirical works that challenge traditional literary tropes.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Understanding genre conventions can help readers better understand and appreciate satirical works that subvert traditional literary tropes.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The marginalization of female authors in previous centuries is being rectified as new critical editions emerge and diversify the literary canon.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Añeja la exclusión de las escritoras femeninas en siglos anteriores, ya que se están publicando nuevas ediciones críticas y diversificando el canón literario.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Advocate for the inclusion of female writers in past centuries as new critical editions and diverse literary canons are being published.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: When interpreting works of metafiction, readers must remain vigilant to the ways in which narrative self-reference can both illuminate and obscure the author's intentions.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Quando se interpretam obras de metaficção, os leitores devem estar atentos às maneiras pelas quais a auto-referência narrativa podem iluminar e obscurar as intenções do autor.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: When interpreting works of fiction, readers should be mindful of how narrative self-reference can illuminate and obscure the author's intentions.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The assembly line halted due to a malfunction in the conveyor belt system this morning.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Abrela la línea de montaje se detuvo debido a un mal funcionamiento del sistema de cinta transportadora esta mañana.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The assembly line stopped this morning due to a malfunction of the conveyor belt system.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The supply chain manager approved a new logistics partner for cross-border shipping services.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: El manager de la cadena de suministro aprobó un nuevo socio de logística para servicios de envío transfronterizo.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The supply chain manager approved a new logistics partner for cross-border shipping services.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: An initial public offering may provide the necessary funds for facility expansion.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: A oferta inicial de público pode fornecer os fundos necessários para a expansão da infraestrutura.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: An initial public offering can provide the necessary funds for infrastructure expansion.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The company adopted ISO 9001 standards to improve its production quality systems.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Aguaytú: la empresa adoptó los estándares ISO 9001 para mejorar sus sistemas de calidad de producción.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Aguaytú: The company adopted ISO 9001 standards to improve its production quality systems.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The procurement team negotiated a bulk discount with the freight carrier.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: El equipo de compra negoció un descuento en masa con el transportista de carga.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The purchasing team negotiated a bulk discount with the freight carrier.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The team brainstormed strategies to optimize warehousing costs.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: El equipo brainstormó estrategias para optimizar los costos de almacenamiento.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The team brainstormed strategies to optimize storage costs.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Market analysts predict rising demand for eco-friendly packaging solutions.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Analistas del mercado prevén un aumento en la demanda de soluciones de embalado ecológico.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Market analysts foresee an increase in demand for eco-friendly packaging solutions.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The distribution center in Rotterdam will handle all international shipments for European clients over the summer to streamline operations and reduce lead times.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: El centro de distribución en Rotterdam manejará todos los envíos internacionales para los clientes europeos durante el verano para optimizar las operaciones y reducir los plazos de entrega.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The distribution center in Rotterdam will handle all international shipments for European customers during the summer to optimize operations and reduce delivery times.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The plant manager explained that, without regular preventive maintenance, downtime in the extrusion process could lead to significant financial losses and missed delivery deadlines.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: El gerente de planta explicó que, sin mantenimiento preventivo regular, el tiempo de inactividad en el proceso de extrusión podría llevar a pérdidas financieras significativas y plazos de entrega perdidos.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The plant manager explained that without regular preventive maintenance, the downtime in the extrusion process could lead to significant financial losses and missed delivery deadlines.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: When the production schedule was disrupted by a supplier default, contingency plans outlined in the risk management protocol were activated by the operations manager immediately.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Quando o cronograma de produção foi interrompido por um atraso do fornecedor, os planos de contingência descritos no protocolo de gerenciamento de riscos foram ativados imediatamente pelo gerente de operações.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: When the production schedule was interrupted due to a delay from the supplier, the contingency plans described in the risk management protocol were immediately activated by the operations manager.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Turnkey solutions offered by the engineering firm allowed the pharmaceutical manufacturer to construct its new facility on time and within budget.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Soluciones llave en mano proporcionadas por la firma de ingeniería ayudaron al fabricante farmacéutico a construir su nuevo centro de producción en tiempo y dentro del presupuesto.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Engineering firm's turnkey solutions helped the pharmaceutical manufacturer build its new production facility on time and within budget.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: If the price of polypropylene continues to rise, plastics manufacturers may have to renegotiate long-term contracts with downstream automotive clients to preserve their margins.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Se o preço do polipropileno continuar a subir, as fabricantes de plásticos podem ter que renegociar contratos a longo prazo com clientes automotivos de baixo-nível para preservar suas margens.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: If the price of polypropylene continues to rise, plastic manufacturers may have to renegotiate long-term contracts with low-end automotive customers to maintain their margins.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The factory introduced a real-time monitoring system to detect bottlenecks along the assembly line and mitigate inefficiencies before they escalate into larger operational problems.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: A fábrica implementou um sistema de monitoramento em tempo real para detectar obstruções na linha de montagem e mitigar ineficacidades antes que se tornem problemas operacionais maiores.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The factory implemented a real-time monitoring system to detect blockages in the assembly line and mitigate inefficiencies before they become major operational issues.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: In the event of a major equipment breakdown, emergency response teams are trained to execute shutdown protocols that prevent harm to both personnel and critical infrastructure.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: En caso de falla grave de equipo, los equipos de respuesta en caso de emergencia están capacitados para ejecutar protocolos de apagado que prevengan daño a la personal y a la infraestructura crítica.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: In case of a critical equipment failure, the emergency response teams are trained to execute shutdown protocols to prevent damage to personnel and critical infrastructure.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: During the annual general meeting, shareholders questioned the CFO about capital allocation strategies and upcoming investments in digital transformation initiatives.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Durante la asamblea general anual, los accionistas interrogaron al CFO sobre las estrategias de asignación de capital y las inversiones futuras en iniciativas de transformación digital.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: During the annual general assembly, shareholders questioned the CFO about the capital allocation strategies and future investments in digital transformation initiatives.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: A detailed analysis of the production workflow highlighted redundant tasks, prompting the operations manager to propose a series of efficiency-driven process improvements.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Analisi detallada do fluxo de produção revelou tarefas redundantes, levando o gerente de operações a propor uma série de melhorias no processo de eficiência.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Detailed analysis of the production flow revealed redundant tasks, leading the operations manager to propose a series of improvements in the efficiency process.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: When evaluating new vendors, the procurement team considers not only cost but also reliability, geographical reach, and regulatory compliance as crucial selection criteria.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: En la evaluación de nuevos proveedores, el equipo de contratación considera no solo el costo, sino también la fiabilidad, el alcance geográfico y la cumplimiento normativo como criterios fundamentales para la selección.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: In the evaluation of new suppliers, the procurement team considers not only cost but also reliability, geographical reach, and regulatory compliance as fundamental criteria for selection.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: She secured a long-term contract to supply parts to an aerospace manufacturer.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Ela conseguiu um contrato a longo prazo para fornecer peças a um fabricante aeroespacial.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: She obtained a long-term contract to supply parts to an aerospace manufacturer.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The union representatives met with management to discuss overtime compensation for weekend shifts.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Los representantes sindicales se reunieron con la gerencia para discutir la compensación por horas extras en turnos de fin de semana.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The trade union representatives met with management to discuss overtime compensation for weekend shifts.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Negotiating with overseas suppliers can present unique language and cultural challenges.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Negociar con proveedores foráneos puede presentar desafíos lingüísticos y culturales únicos.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Foreign supplier negotiation can present unique linguistic and cultural challenges.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Sales representatives distributed product catalogs at the industry trade fair.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Los representantes de ventas distribuyeron catálogos de productos en la feria de la industria.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Sales representatives distributed product catalogs at the industry fair.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The quality control engineer detected microfractures in several shipments of aluminum rods.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: El ingeniero de control de calidad detectó microfracturas en varias cargas de barras de aluminio.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The quality control engineer detected microcracks in several loads of aluminum bars.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: A power outage in the manufacturing district delayed order fulfillment by several hours.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Ava un apagón en la zona de fabricación retrasó el cumplimiento de las órdenes por varias horas.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: A power outage in the manufacturing zone delayed the fulfillment of orders for several hours.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Corporate social responsibility initiatives have reshaped the branding strategies of many major industry players.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Aspectos de responsabilidad social corporativa han reformado las estrategias de marca de muchos jugadores industriales importantes.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Corporate social responsibility aspects have reformed the branding strategies of many important industrial players.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The logistics coordinator optimized truck routes to minimize empty miles and reduce fuel consumption.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: El coordinador de logística optimizó los itinerarios de camiones para minimizar las millas vacías y reducir el consumo de combustible.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The logistics coordinator optimized truck routes to minimize empty miles and reduce fuel consumption.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: By centralizing procurement processes, the company streamlined approvals and achieved considerable cost savings within one fiscal year, according to internal performance reviews.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: La centralización de los procesos de compra por parte de la empresa agilizó los apruebas y logró importantes ahorros en costos en un año fiscal, según los informes de rendimiento internos.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The company's centralization of purchasing processes sped up approvals and achieved significant cost savings in a fiscal year, according to internal performance reports.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The new software for supply chain management automates purchase orders and tracks shipments from suppliers to warehouses in real time, improving transparency.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: El nuevo software de gestión de cadena de suministro automatiza los pedidos de compra y sigue los envíos desde los proveedores hasta los almacenes en tiempo real, mejorando la transparencia.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The new supply chain management software automates purchase orders and tracks shipments in real-time, enhancing transparency.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Our long-standing textile client extended their original contract after we provided a custom solution that minimized fabric waste during production runs.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Nuestro cliente textil con larga duración extendió su contrato original después de que nosotros proporcionáramos una solución personalizada que minimizó el desperdicio de tela durante las corridas de producción.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Our textile client extended their original contract after we provided a customized solution that minimized fabric waste during production runs.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The external consultant recommended consolidating multiple storage sites into a single logistics hub to lower fixed operational costs by at least 12 percent annually.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: El consultor externo recomendó consolidar múltiples centros de almacenamiento en un solo centro de logística para reducir costos fijos en al menos 12 por ciento anualmente.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The external consultant recommended consolidating multiple storage centers into a single logistics center to reduce fixed costs by at least 12% annually.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Their new fulfillment strategy utilizes automated guided vehicles, which pick and move pallets through the warehouse, reducing manual labor and risk of injury.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Su estrategia de satisfacción nueva utiliza vehículos guiados por guía automática, que recogen y mueven paletes a través de la bodega, reduciendo el trabajo manual y el riesgo de lesión.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Their new satisfaction strategy uses guided vehicles with automatic guides that collect and move pallets through the warehouse, reducing manual labor and injury risk.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: After facing production delays due to machine malfunctions, the engineering team implemented predictive maintenance tools, preventing similar setbacks during subsequent manufacturing cycles.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Por causa de atrasos en la producción atribuibles a problemas de máquinas, el equipo de ingeniería implementó herramientas de mantenimiento predictivo, evitando así que ocurrieran problemas similares en ciclos de fabricación posteriores.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Due to production delays caused by machine issues, the engineering team implemented predictive maintenance tools, thereby preventing similar problems in future production cycles.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Executives from North American and Asian firms met to negotiate contractual terms for a multi-year joint venture in precision components manufacturing.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Executivos de firmas norteamericanas y asiáticas se reunieron para negociar términos contractuales para una empresa conjunta multianual en fabricación de componentes de precisión.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: American and Asian executives met to negotiate contractual terms for a multinational joint venture in precision component manufacturing.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Market trends indicate that digitizing maintenance scheduling can lower downtime for heavy machinery in large-scale industrial plants, as reported in recent trade publications.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Trendos do mercado indican que a digitalização do agendamento de manutenção pode reduzir o tempo de indisponibilidade para máquinas pesadas em grandes plantas industriais, conforme relatado em publicações comerciais recentes.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Market trends indicate that digitalization of maintenance scheduling can reduce downtime time for heavy machinery in large industrial plants, as reported in recent commercial publications.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: He emphasized that supply chain resilience becomes especially critical when disruptions from geopolitical tensions affect the steady flow of imported raw materials.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Ele enfatizou que a resiliência da cadeia de suprimentos se torna especialmente crítica quando as distúrbios provocados pelas tensões geopolíticas afetam o fluxo constante de matérias-primas importadas.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: He emphasized that supply chain resilience becomes especially critical when geopolitical tensions disrupt the steady flow of imported raw materials.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: They plan to export their latest product line to Europe, pending certifications and an agreement with a local wholesaler in Germany.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Están planeando exportar su línea de productos más reciente a Europa, mientras aguardan certificaciones y un acuerdo con un minorista local en Alemania.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: They are planning to export their latest product line to Europe, while they wait for certifications and an agreement with a local retailer in Germany.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Corporate restructuring will result in a new divisional hierarchy, with regional managers reporting directly to the chief operating officer rather than the general manager.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: La reorganización corporativa resultará en una jerarquía divisional nueva, con los gerentes regionales reportando directamente al consejero delegado de operaciones regionales en lugar del gerente general.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The corporate reorganization will result in a new divisional hierarchy, with regional managers reporting directly to the regional operations CEO instead of the general manager.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The production supervisor implemented a continuous improvement framework, enabling staff to propose new ideas for optimizing assembly protocols and reducing cycle times.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: El supervisor de producción implementó un marco de mejora continua, lo que permitió a los empleados proponer nuevas ideas para optimizar los protocolos de ensamblaje y reducir los tiempos de ciclo.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The production supervisor implemented a continuous improvement framework, enabling employees to propose new ideas to optimize assembly protocols and reduce cycle times.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: While light manufacturing can often be near city centers, heavy industry usually requires extensive infrastructure and must be sited outside residential areas.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: En la manufactura ligera puede estar cerca de los centros urbanos, pero la industria pesada requiere una infraestructura extensa y debe estar situada lejos de las áreas residenciales.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Light manufacturing can be near urban centers, but heavy industry requires extensive infrastructure and should be located far from residential areas.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: He suggested launching a new B2B e-commerce portal to provide enterprise clients with bulk pricing options, live inventory data, and expedited shipping selections.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Ele sugirió lanzar un nuevo portal B2B en línea para ofrecer opciones de precios en masa a los clientes empresariales, datos en tiempo real de inventario y opciones de envío aceleradas.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: He suggested launching a new online B2B portal to offer mass pricing options to business clients, real-time inventory data, and expedited shipping options.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The facility manager cited safety violations in last week's incident report, recommending additional training for forklift operators handling hazardous materials in storage areas.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: El administrador del recinto señaló violaciones de seguridad en el informe de la semana pasada, recomendando capacitación adicional para los operadores de forklift que manejan materiales peligrosos en áreas de almacenamiento.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The facility manager pointed out security breaches in the weekly report, recommending additional training for forklift operators handling hazardous materials in storage areas.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: If buyer demand for on-time delivery increases, freight forwarders may invest in more sophisticated tracking and tracing technologies across their entire fleet.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Se o comprador demand por entrega em tempo hábil aumenta, os correios podem investir em tecnologias de rastreamento e rastreamento mais sofisticadas em toda a sua frota.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: When the buyer demands for timely delivery, the post office may invest in advanced tracking technologies for their entire fleet.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Their newest warehouse utilizes vertical storage systems, enabling greater inventory density on a reduced square footage footprint compared to their older logistics facilities.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: El nuevo almacén de ellos utiliza sistemas de almacenamiento verticales, lo que permite una mayor densidad de inventario en una superficie más reducida en comparación con sus instalaciones logísticas anteriores.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Their new warehouse uses vertical storage systems, enabling a higher inventory density in a smaller space compared to their previous logistics facilities.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: When presenting to potential clients, the business development team highlighted the company's flexible contract manufacturing capabilities, including rapid prototyping and small batch production.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: En presentar a posibles clientes, el equipo de desarrollo de negocio destacó las capacidades flexibles de fabricación de contratos de la empresa, incluyendo la prototipado rápido y la producción en serie pequeña.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The business development team highlighted the flexible manufacturing capabilities of the company's contract agreements, including rapid prototyping and small-batch production.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Following a competitive tender process, the enterprise awarded the packaging supply contract to an international firm that satisfied sustainability criteria and offered favorable lead times for custom orders.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: After un proceso competitivo de licitación, la empresa adjudicó el contrato de suministro de envases a una firma internacional que cumplió con los criterios de sostenibilidad y ofreció plazos de entrega favorables para los pedidos personalizados.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: After a competitive bidding process, the company awarded the contract for packaging supply to an international firm that met sustainability criteria and offered favorable delivery terms for customized orders.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The export compliance officer verified all shipping documentation met international trade requirements before authorizing cargo movement from the main distribution center to ports abroad.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: El oficial de cumplimiento de exportación verificó que todos los documentos de envío cumplían con los requisitos de comercio internacional antes de autorizar el movimiento de carga desde el centro de distribución principal a los puertos en el extranjero.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The export compliance officer verified that all shipping documents met international trade requirements before authorizing the cargo movement from the main distribution center to foreign ports.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Prior to rolling out the lean management initiative, executives reviewed performance indicators in every department, designating improvement teams to tackle operational bottlenecks and optimize resource allocation.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Antes de implementar la iniciativa de gestión al estilo de seda, los ejecutivos revisaron los indicadores de rendimiento en cada departamento, designando equipos de mejora para abordar los puntos de cuello y optimizar la asignación de recursos.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Before implementing the management initiative in a'silk' style, executives reviewed performance indicators in each department, forming teams for improvement to address bottlenecks and optimize resource allocation.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: In response to customer feedback about missed delivery windows, the logistics director commissioned a route optimization analysis to streamline last-mile deliveries across five metropolitan service areas.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: En respuesta a la feedback del cliente sobre ventanas de entrega perdidas, el director de logística comisionó un análisis de optimización de rutas para optimizar las entregas finales en cinco áreas metropolitanas de servicio.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: In response to customer feedback on lost delivery windows, the logistics director commissioned an optimization analysis of routes to improve final deliveries in five service metropolitan areas.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Monthly production targets were exceeded for three consecutive quarters thanks to the integration of advanced process control systems and investment in workforce development and training programs.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Los objetivos de producción mensuales fueron superados durante tres trimestres consecutivos gracias a la integración de sistemas de control de procesos avanzados y la inversión en programas de desarrollo y capacitación del personal.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Monthly production targets were exceeded for three consecutive quarters due to the integration of advanced process control systems and investment in staff development and training programs.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: As the leading provider of industrial adhesives, the company regularly conducts technical seminars to train client engineers and increase adoption of their proprietary bonding technologies.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Como líder en proveedores de adhesivos industriales, la empresa realiza regularmente seminarios técnicos para capacitar ingenieros de clientes y aumentar la adopción de sus tecnologías de unión propietarias.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: As a leading industrial adhesive supplier, the company regularly conducts technical workshops to train customer engineers and increase adoption of their proprietary bonding technologies.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Because supply chain visibility remains a top priority, the enterprise has adopted blockchain-based tracking for all high-value shipments and strategic raw materials across its global network.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Por causa da visibilidade da cadeia de suprimentos continuar sendo uma prioridade, a empresa adotou rastreamento baseado em blockchain para todos os envios de alta importância e materiais estratégicos em todo o seu rediloco global.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Due to the continued importance of supply chain visibility, the company has adopted blockchain-based tracking for all high-value shipments and strategic materials across its global network.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: This monitor supports both HDMI and DisplayPort connections for flexible setups.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Este monitor soporta conexiones HDMI y DisplayPort, para configuraciones flexibles.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: This monitor supports HDMI and DisplayPort connections, for flexible configurations.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The touchpad gestures on this ultrabook make multitasking much easier.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Aqui o tecleiro de gestos no ecrã táctil deste ultrabook facilita muito o multitasking.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: This ultrabook's touchscreen keyboard significantly enhances multitasking.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Is your webcam HD ready, or does it only support 720p video?
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: ¿Es tu webcam preparada para HD o solo admite video en 720p?
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Is your webcam prepared for HD or only supports 720p video?

rtt_translation.source_text_en: A solid-state drive significantly improves boot times compared to a mechanical hard drive.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Unidad de estado sólido mejora significativamente los tiempos de inicio en comparación con un disco duro mecánico.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The solid-state drive significantly improves start-up times compared to a mechanical hard disk.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Most noise-canceling headphones now use advanced digital signal processing.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Los auriculares con cancelación de ruido ahora utilizan procesamiento de señal digital avanzado.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Headphones with noise cancellation now use advanced digital signal processing.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: This e-reader uses e-ink technology to reduce eye strain during long reading sessions.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Este leitor electrónico utiliza tecnología e-ink para reducir el cansancio de los ojos durante sesiones de lectura prolongadas.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: This electronic reader uses e-ink technology to reduce eye strain during long reading sessions.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: When did you upgrade your PC's RAM to 32 gigabytes?
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: ¿Cuándo actualizó su PC la memoria RAM a 32 gigabytes?
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: When did he/she update his/her PC's RAM to 32 gigabytes?

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The power supply unit must have enough wattage to support all components.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: El equipo de alimentación debe tener suficientes watts para soportar todos los componentes.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The power supply team must have sufficient watts to support all components.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Do not attempt to open the case while the device is still connected to power.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: No se intente abrir el caso mientras el dispositivo esté conectado a la energía.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Do not try to open the case while the device is connected to power.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The system BIOS controls hardware initialization during the computer's boot process.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: El BIOS del sistema controla la inicialización de hardware durante el proceso de arranque del computador.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The system BIOS controls the initializing of hardware during the computer boot process.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: If the audio output is distorted, you should check the headphone jack and ensure no debris is obstructing the contact points.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Se o áudio estiver distorcido, verifique o conector de ouvido e certifique-se de que não há nenhum objeto obstruindo os pontos de contato.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: If the audio is distorted, check the earphone connector and ensure there's no object obstructing the contact points.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Wireless charging pads use electromagnetic induction to transfer energy between the charger and a compatible device.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: ESG investing considers environmental, social, and governance factors in financial decision-making.

rtt_translation.translated_en_text: ESG investing considers environmental, social, and governance factors in financial decisions.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Forex trading involves pairs like USD/EUR or JPY/GBP, each with its own volatility profile.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: El comercio de divisas envolve pares como USD/EUR o JPY/GBP, cada uno con su propio perfil de volatilidad.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Currency trading involves pairs such as USD/EUR or JPY/GBP, each with its own volatility profile.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: She uses a zero-based budgeting method to allocate every dollar of her monthly income.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Ella usa un método de presupuesto basado en cero para distribuir cada dólar de su ingreso mensual.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: She uses a zero-based budgeting method to distribute every dollar of her monthly income.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Credit default swaps transfer the risk of borrower default from one party to another for a premium.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Los swaps de seguro de defaulto transfieren el riesgo de defaulto del prestatario de un tercero a otro por una prima.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Default insurance swaps transfer the risk of default from the borrower to another party for a premium.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The chief investment officer remarked that the growing appeal of thematic ETFs reflects investors' desire to align financial goals with personal values without sacrificing portfolio diversification or liquidity.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: El jefe de la oficina de inversiones observó que el creciente interés en los ETFs temáticos refleja el deseo de los inversores de alinear sus objetivos financieros con sus valores personales sin sacrificar la diversificación del portafolio o la liquidez.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The office investment department head observed that the growing interest in thematic ETFs reflects investors' desire to align their financial goals with their personal values without sacrificing portfolio diversification or liquidity.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Planning for retirement requires not just saving, but also choosing vehicles that minimize tax exposure while ensuring steady post-career income streams for decades.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Planning para a aposentadoria requer não apenas o acúmulo de recursos, mas também a escolha de veículos que minimizem a exposição tributária e garantam renda estável para décadas após a aposentadoria.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Planning for retirement requires not only the accumulation of resources but also the selection of vehicles that minimize tax exposure and ensure stable income for decades after retirement.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Inflation-protected securities such as TIPS adjust their principal based on changes to the Consumer Price Index, helping investors preserve purchasing power over time.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Securities protegidos por la inflación, como los TIPS, ajustan su capital en función de los cambios en el Índice de Precios al Consumidor, ayudando a los inversores a preservar su poder adquisitivo a lo largo del tiempo.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Securities protected by inflation, such as TIPS, adjust their capital based on changes in the Consumer Price Index, helping investors to preserve their purchasing power over time.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: In the aftermath of the 2008 financial crisis, regulatory agencies introduced stricter capital requirements to reduce the systemic risk posed by large, highly leveraged financial institutions.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Na financia crisis 2008, asias reguladoras impuseron mayores requisitos de capital para reducir el riesgo sistémico de instituciones financieras grandes y altamente endeudadas.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: In response to the 2008 financial crisis, Asian regulators imposed stricter capital requirements to reduce the systemic risk of large and highly leveraged financial institutions.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Because high-frequency trading firms operate with razor-thin margins, even a fraction of a cent's advantage per trade can generate substantial profits when multiplied across millions of daily transactions.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Porque as firmas de negociação de alta frequência operam com margens finas, mesmo um centavo de vantagem por negociação pode gerar lucros substanciais quando multiplicados por milhões de transações diárias.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Because high-frequency trading signatures operate with thin margins, even a small advantage in each trade can generate substantial profits when multiplied by millions of daily transactions.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: If I had known about the early withdrawal penalties, I would not have liquidated my individual retirement account before turning fifty-nine and a half years old.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Si yo supiera sobre las penalidades de salida temprana, no hubiera liquidado mi cuenta de retiro individual antes de cumplir cincuenta y nueve años y medio.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: If I had known about early withdrawal penalties, I wouldn't have liquidated my individual retirement account before turning 59 1/2 years old.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The volatility index, often called the VIX, serves as the market's 'fear gauge' by measuring expected stock market fluctuations derived from S&P 500 options data.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: El índice de volatilidad, comúnmente llamado VIX, actúa como un indicador de 'cuenta atrás' del mercado, midiendo las expectativas de fluctuaciones en el mercado bursátil derivadas de los datos de opciones del S&P 500
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The volatility index, commonly known as VIX, serves as a forward-looking indicator, measuring market participants' expectations of future volatility in the S&P 500 stock market based on option data.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: If she had rebalanced her portfolio annually, she might have achieved a smoother risk-return profile throughout the last market cycle.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Se ella tivesse reequilibrado seu portfólio anualmente, talvez tivesse alcançado um perfil de risco-retorno mais suave durante o último ciclo do mercado.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: If she had rebalanced her portfolio annually, she might have achieved a more moderate risk-return profile during the last market cycle.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Quantitative analysts, or quants, develop mathematical models to identify arbitrage opportunities and predict asset price movements across a wide range of financial instruments.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Analistas quantitativos, ou quants, desenvolvem modelos matemáticos para identificar oportunidades de arbitragem e prever movimentos de preços de ativos em uma ampla gama de instrumentos financeiros.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Quantitative analysts, or quants, develop mathematical models to identify arbitrage opportunities and predict price movements of various financial instruments.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The investment committee emphasized that diversification across geographic regions—rather than just asset classes—can help mitigate risks from concentrated political or economic shocks.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: El comité de inversión enfatizó que la diversificación geográfica, en lugar de solo en clases de activos, puede ayudar a mitigar los riesgos de impactos políticos o económicos concentrados.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: The investment committee emphasized that geographical diversification, in addition to asset classes, can help mitigate the risks of concentrated political or economic impacts.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: According to regulatory filings, several hedge funds increased their stakes in blue-chip technology companies during the first quarter, betting on resilient earnings growth despite uncertain macroeconomic conditions.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: De acuerdo con los registros regulatorios, varios fondos de cobertura incrementaron sus posiciones en compañías tecnológicas de alta calidad durante el primer trimestre, apostando por un crecimiento sólido de ganancias a pesar de las condiciones macroeconómicas inciertas.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: According to regulatory records, several hedge funds increased their positions in high-quality technology companies during the first quarter, betting on solid earnings growth despite uncertain macroeconomic conditions.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The yield curve inversion in 2019 was interpreted by many market participants as a harbinger of economic recession and triggered broad asset reallocation among professional portfolio managers.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: En 2019, la inversión en curva de rendimiento se interpretó por muchos participantes del mercado como un presagio de recesión económica y desencadenó una reasignación generalizada de activos entre los gestores de portafolios profesionales
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: In 2019, the investment performance curve was interpreted by many market participants as a precursor to a recession and triggered a widespread reallocation of assets among professional portfolio managers.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Should interest rates rise quickly, borrowers with variable-rate loans could experience a dramatic increase in monthly interest expenses, straining household budgets and possibly leading to higher default rates.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: En caso de que aumenten rápidamente las tasas de interés, los prestatarios con préstamos variables podrían experimentar un aumento dramático en los gastos de intereses mensuales, estresando los presupuestos familiares y posiblemente llevando a tasas de defaulto más altas.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: In case of rapidly increasing interest rates, borrowers with variable loans could experience a dramatic increase in monthly interest expenses, straining family budgets and potentially leading to higher default rates.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: The chef sprinkled Maldon sea salt over the caramelized scallops before serving.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: O chef, antes de servir, polvilhou sal de mar de Maldon sobre as alcatras caramelizadas.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Before serving, the chef sprinkled Maldon sea salt over the caramelized shallots.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Sourdough bread requires a living starter to achieve its distinctive tangy flavor.

rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Saracen bread needs a live leavening agent to achieve its distinctive sour flavor.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Sushi rice must be seasoned with rice vinegar, sugar, and salt.

rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Rice for sushi should be seasoned with rice vinegar, sugar, and salt.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Poaching eggs in acidulated water helps them retain their shape.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: Usar agua ácida para cocer los huevos ayuda a mantener su forma.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: Using acidic water to cook eggs helps maintain their shape.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Afternoon tea typically includes finger sandwiches, scones, and petits fours.
rtt_translation.translated_gn_text: El té de la tarde normalmente incluye paninis, scones y petiscos.
rtt_translation.translated_en_text: In the afternoon tea normally includes sandwiches, scones, and snacks.

rtt_translation.source_text_en: Al dente' pasta should have a slight bite when properly cooked.
